doc.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021

title: Closing: returning to live performance
summary: Thanks and goodbyes; she is excited and overwhelmed to be playing for audiences again after the pandemic.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’m definitely looking forward to meeting you personally and hearing your music tomorrow.
Best of luck with the rest of your career. How’s that for a long term investment?

Yeah. It’s kind of interesting because after being home for a year and a half it kind of went for a second here from zero to a hundred. And it’s a little bit overwhelming I have to say, but you know I’m also very grateful and enjoy it while it lasts because we don’t know what’s going to happen tomorrow. So there’s opportunity to play a few shows and to play live for people and I’m really really excited about that, because I did miss the exchange with the audience, to feel other people, to share energy, so I’m very excited and happy and grateful to be able to have this opportunity tomorrow and in general.
